decision: Test whether the replicated horizon-4 planning gain requires candidate/terminal-privileged positive-anchor selection during training. Run seed-0 information- and optimization-matched hard-selection and random-selection controls by overriding only proposal selection on the established no-replay recipe, then evaluate the fixed deployment-feasible current-buffer GAR policy at 128 episodes, 256 candidates, and horizon 4. The positive-anchor seed-0 reference is 0.09139 normalized edit-distance improvement. If either target-free control is healthy (finite losses, state effective rank at least 50, token-aligned shuffled-action error ratio above 1) and reaches at least 0.08 improvement, advance the better target-free recipe to seeds 1 and 2. If both are healthy but below 0.05, conclude that the current planning result depends materially on privileged training-anchor selection and prioritize a deployable proposal-learning mechanism rather than more horizon or replay tuning. Intermediate outcomes require one targeted replication of the better control. Random selection is the negative control; all planning candidates and scores remain target-free.
